result.summary: The street is a narrow residential corridor characterized by row houses and continuous on-street parking that creates significant visual obstructions. There is a complete absence of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures, and the narrow sidewalks are further constrained by utility poles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous parking on both sides of the narrow street creates significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the street view.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated areas for pedestrians to cross the street are visible, increasing the risk of mid-block crossings in low-visibility areas.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections to improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow, one-way residential street with row houses and continuous sidewalks on both sides. While the narrow street width naturally limits vehicle speeds, the intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no visible painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Inaccessible curbs
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps creates a physical barrier for pedestrians with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the sidewalk in the foreground

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface shows signs of cracking and wear, which can create tripping hazards or uneven surfaces.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Use paint or bollards to prevent parking near the corner, ensuring clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: A narrow residential street lined with row houses and parked cars on both sides. While the narrow roadway geometry likely encourages lower vehicle speeds, there is a total absence of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control infrastructure visible.

hazards.description: There are no designated or marked locations for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions or 'daylighting' at corners to prevent parking near intersections and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential one-way street with row houses and a sidewalk that is partially obstructed by a parked vehicle and debris. While sidewalks are present, the lack of visible crossing infrastructure and the presence of physical obstructions reduce the overall pedestrian safety and accessibility.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A silver sedan is parked across the sidewalk area in front of a garage, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, in front of the white garage door

hazards.name: Debris and Litter
hazards.description: Accumulated trash and debris on the sidewalk and in the gutter create tripping hazards and degrade the walking environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side sidewalk and gutter area

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement
interventions.description: Strict enforcement of parking regulations to prevent vehicles from blocking the sidewalk and garage access points.

interventions.title: Street Maintenance and Cleaning
interventions.description: Regular removal of debris and repair of cracked pavement to ensure a clear and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: If feasible, widening the sidewalk to provide more space for pedestrians and reduce the impact of minor obstructions.
